blockingIssues.description: register_attached/unregister_attached still do unlocked read-modify-write (`load_attached_registry` -> mutate -> `save_attached_registry`). The new unique tmp filename in save_attached_registry removes tmp-path collisions, but concurrent writers can still overwrite each other's logical updates (last-writer-wins), so the prior blocking race from fix-git-and-persistence-issues is not fully resolved.
